mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a -2% y/y drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point increase over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by > 5 points in the month following the UNRATE trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, signals a looming recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve steepens by > 50 basis points within the next 3 months, indicating that recession risks have abated.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% year-over-year decline in the HOUST index, signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Existing home sales (EXHOSL) rise by > 5% in the month following the HOUST trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate, defined as a 50 basis point hike over the past month, signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS cuts rates by > 25 basis points within the next 2 months, indicating a policy reversal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales, as measured by the year-over-year change in the RSAFS index, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Retail inventories (RETAILIC) fall by > 5% in the month following the RSAFS trigger, indicating that sales weakness is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in payroll employment, as measured by the year-over-year change in the PAYEMS index, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims (ICSA) rise by > 10% in the month following the PAYEMS trigger, indicating that labor market strength is fleeting.
